reference_integrity: Apple reference PNG and scene JSON hashes match the hashes recorded in capture metadata; the capture source scripts changed after the references were produced, so these are retained references with provenance rather than freshly revalidated captures.
comparison_recipe: Rows are probes A/C/D; columns are the retained Apple reference, Flutter host capture, and per-channel absolute RGB difference amplified x4 (clipped to 255). Native 3x crops, no registration, resampling, or color adjustment. Frozen blend-32 merge candidate frames are bundled under raw/merge-blend32-{A,C,D}.png; toolbar candidate frames remain at /tmp/liquid-glass-blog-captures/regular. Original recipe: /tmp/liquid-glass-blog-captures/compose_comparisons.py; blend-32 recipe: /tmp/liquid-glass-real-heroes/compose_merge32.py.
presets: Shipped optical and appearance presets with unchanged scene geometry. The toolbar uses unmodified ios27Light; the merge pair uses ios27Clear plus a scene-specific blend radius of 32, selected on probes C/D before capturing A. No optical optimizer fit or exterior-shadow overrides. Comparison references are SDR, not HDR.
style: Figures use the whynotmake.it look: grained paper background, Space Grotesk labels, blue/coral accents (example/tool/compose_blog_figures.py, example/tool/blog_cover.py).
